# Atmosphere

> Atmosphere is intelligence for contractors. Crews film the work on site with Field Capture; the Atmosphere Platform checks each clip at the door, reads it with AI against the agreed scope, holds it in a chain of custody, and gives the office a complete job record it can share with customers and reviewers.

Atmosphere is one system with two parts, not separate purchases:

- **Field Capture**: how crews record the walk-through and daily work on site. Footage uploads to the Platform.
- **Platform**: where footage is checked (filmed on site, filmed today), read against the scope, stored with a SHA-256 custody log, and shared.

Self-serve plans (every plan includes Field Capture and the Platform, plus an AI usage allowance; buy credits if you need more):

- Starter: $399/mo, 1 Field Capture account
- Work Verification: $849/mo, 3 Field Capture accounts
- Scale: $1,999/mo, 10 Field Capture accounts
- Extra Field Capture accounts: $125/mo each. Homeowners invited to a job file pay nothing. Enterprise terms are arranged with sales.
- Optional Field Capture Chest Mount: $99.99 one-time, ships in 2–5 business days.

Production AI vendors are configured not to train on customer data, and Atmosphere does not use an organization's job or account data to train shared models.

## Product

- [How it works](https://atmosphereteam.com/how-it-works): the full pipeline, from the walk-through on site through integrity checks, AI reading against the scope, chain of custody, and sharing
- [Platform](https://atmosphereteam.com/verification): record, verify, store, and share
- [Field Capture](https://atmosphereteam.com/field): film and check work on site
- [Chest Mount](https://atmosphereteam.com/hardware): hands-free Field Capture kit
- [Accessories](https://atmosphereteam.com/accessories): Chest Mount, chargers, battery packs
- [Pricing](https://atmosphereteam.com/pricing): plans, seats, usage, and FAQ
